comparison.objective: Open an anti-static bag, remove one cell, and orient it in a holder; candidate depins one terminal from a connector housing.
comparison.physical_skill: Zipper actuation and cell pick/place versus wire deflection, recessed single-blade insertion, and simultaneous tool-wire withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Bag opened, selected cell seated positive-up, other cell retained, arms returned; candidate requires terminal release with housing, crimp, and neighbors intact, but exact force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: The tested mechanisms and end states are unrelated despite both requiring selective handling.
